replacement_review.assertion: Reserve-yield changes contributed more than half of the FY2024-to-FY2025 change in reserve income.
replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: The supplied operations provide annual reserve income. The definitions state that yield and average circulation both affect reserve income, but do not provide the separate constant-balance rate contribution needed to decide this causal majority claim.

construction_revision.maintenance_rationale: A stablecoin issuer cost model can appear to improve solely because the adjusted definition changes. Updating both bases, deriving nine-month comparisons and reconciling two different margin denominators produces an actionable research artifact without inventing an interest-rate attribution.

public_definition_addenda.expense_model: prior_residual_usd_thousand is reconstructed prior-definition expense (GAAP expense plus signed prior adjustments) less independently reported prior-definition expense. new_residual_usd_thousand is reconstructed new-definition expense (GAAP expense plus signed prior and extra adjustments) less independently reported new-definition expense.
public_definition_addenda.operating_margins: Reconstructed revenue is reserve income plus other revenue. Reconstructed costs are distribution plus other costs. RLDC is reconstructed revenue less reconstructed costs. revenue_usd_thousand is the reconstructed component sum. rldc_margin_pct is 100 times reconstructed RLDC divided by reconstructed revenue. adjusted_ebitda_margin_pct is 100 times independently reported adjusted EBITDA divided by reconstructed RLDC. revenue_residual_usd_thousand is reconstructed revenue less independently reported total revenue. cost_residual_usd_thousand is reconstructed costs less independently reported total costs. The component-based RLDC margin is an analytical reconstruction and can differ from the issuer-reported margin when the reported total differs from its components.
